title: Can a straight angle be split into two equal angles?
description: The cover of a notebook is opened half a turn, so its two arms lie in one line. A ray from the corner splits this straight angle into two angles, and folding the paper so that one arm lands on the other shows the crease that makes them equal. Keeko's doubt is that a straight angle is only a line and cannot be split.
teaching_notes: One idea: a straight angle is half a turn, and the crease that lands one arm on the other splits it into two equal angles. Watch for students who think a straight angle is only a line and not an angle.
